company.name: Cousins Maine Lobster
company.one_liner: A food truck serving authentic Maine lobster rolls in Los Angeles.

facts.summary: Two cousins from Maine run a lobster food truck in LA, sourcing lobster directly from Maine. They want to grow into more trucks and more cities.
highlights: One truck did about $150,000 in sales in its first two months.
Lobster comes straight from Maine, which is their brand story.
Food trucks are cheaper to open than restaurants.
They plan to expand with more trucks and possibly franchising.

real_deal.summary: Barbara Corcoran invested $55,000 for 15% (about a $367K valuation).

outcome.headline: Grew into a national franchise with dozens of trucks and restaurants.
outcome.story: Cousins Maine Lobster franchised its trucks across the US, with dozens of units and reported annual revenue near $39M by 2023. It's private, so the value here (~$50M) is an estimate.
